the extended theory of planned behaviour model (TPB), incorporating additions of perceived usefulness, perceived enjoyment, and perceived ease of use, is an appropriate model to examine the determinants of intention to use and actual usage of social networking sites.

The extended TPB variables, namely, attitude, perceived behavioral controll, perceived usefulness and percieved enjoyment, have a significant effect on the intention to use social network site, which in turns positively affects actual usage.
